svg.title: Same quarter totals, different ponded durations

cc:Work.dc:title: Same quarter totals, different ponded durations
cc:Work.dc:description: Three authored first-quarter rain cases, each showing shortest and longest duration-attaining rain histories, exactly reflected surface water including interior drainage, and strictly ponded intervals. Fixed dry-start infiltration capacity 6 mm/hour and rain cap 20 mm/hour. Not field observations or pointwise water envelopes.

g.text: Within each column: same quarter totals, different ponded durations
Authored model: dry start, infiltration capacity 6 mm/hour, rain cap 20 mm/hour; assumed half-hour totals 5 + 5 mm, third-quarter total 2 mm.
Open bar endpoints mean zero surface water; isolated endpoints have zero duration. These are duration-attaining histories,
not pointwise water envelopes or field observations. Exact interior drainage splits are shown; no new model run.
